description: This PHP source file defines the AdminUserRole class which extends AbstractUserRole and manages user role permissions within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes traits for various services, methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on permissions, and defines role-based access controls for entities like Employee, User, Location, Project, Customer, and others.

classes.name: AdminUserRole
classes.description: Class managing user role permissions, extending AbstractUserRole, implementing methods to retrieve accessible entity IDs based on permissions, and incorporating multiple traits for service access.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LocationService instance used within the role to access location data.

methods.name: getAccessibleIdsForEntity
methods.description: Returns IDs of entities accessible to the current user based on entity type and permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeIds
methods.description: Fetches list of employee IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleLocationIds
methods.description: Fetches list of location IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleSystemUserIds
methods.description: Fetches list of system user IDs accessible based on permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleUserRoleIds
methods.description: Fetches list of user role IDs that are assignable under current permissions.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Returns employees associated with this user role.

methods.name: getAccessibleProjectIds
methods.description: Fetches list of project IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCustomerIds
methods.description: Fetches list of customer IDs accessible with current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleVacancyIds
methods.description: Fetches list of vacancy IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerIds
methods.description: Fetches list of performance tracker IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleReviewIds
methods.description: Fetches list of performance review IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleTrackerLogIds
methods.description: Fetches list of tracker log IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateIds
methods.description: Fetches list of candidate IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewIds
methods.description: Fetches list of interview IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleInterviewAttachmentIds
methods.description: Fetches list of interview attachment IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateHistoryIds
methods.description: Fetches list of candidate history IDs accessible under current permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleCandidateActionHistoryIds
methods.description: Returns IDs for candidate action histories, possibly with special access logic.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Returns the list of quick launch actions available to the user based on permissions.
